import importlib.util,json,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('canonical/runtime/goal_compiler.py')

reg=json.loads(pathlib.Path('canonical/runtime/BOUND_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY_V1.json').read_text())['capabilities']

assert out.get('clause_coverage_verified') is True,out
assert sorted(p['index'] for p in out['compiled_parts'])==[0,1,2,3],out['compiled_parts']
types=[a.get('type') for a in out['controller_actions']]
assert types==['invoke_capability_fallback','assert_runtime_fallback_decision','finish'],types
fb=out['controller_actions'][0]
assert fb['args']['primary_action']['args']['capability_id']=='web.browser.rendered.capture.chromedriver',fb
assert fb['args']['fallback_action']['args']['capability_id']=='web.browser.rendered.capture.chromedriver',fb
assert fb['args']['decision_path']=='canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/FALLBACK_DECISION.json',fb
assert not any('docx' in json.dumps(x).lower() for x in out['compiled_parts']),out['compiled_parts']
